Message:
bpf: Fix leak in LINK_UPDATE and enforce empty old_prog_fd

Fix bug of not putting bpf_link in LINK_UPDATE command.
Also enforce zeroed old_prog_fd if no BPF_F_REPLACE flag is specified.
